title: Returned-Payment Fee Charge on the Home Purchase Agreement — Desk Tool Card
content:
**Policy.** When the buyer's bank returns a deposit payment on a Home Purchase Agreement unpaid, the return comes off the deposits held and Calloway charges the buyer for it. Each returned deposit payment carries one returned-payment fee charge. The charge names the receipt number of the returned payment, the fee for one return is charged once, and the charge is dated the day it is booked; a return whose fee has not yet been booked carries it from the day the return is next handled.

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool `assess_returned_payment_fee_3b45ee8d` books the returned-payment fee for one deposit payment that the buyer's bank returned unpaid on a Home Purchase Agreement. One call adds a single charge line of type returned payment fee to the agreement's buyer statement, naming the receipt number of the returned payment and the amount charged, dated today, under a newly printed charge number. The agreement's fees-and-per-diem balance owed by the buyer rises by the same amount, and the buyer sees the charge line on the statement.

**How it is invoked.** `assess_returned_payment_fee_3b45ee8d` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_id` | The reference number identifying the Home Purchase Agreement the returned payment belonged to, as returned by the purchase agreement lookup for this buyer | Identifier |
| `source_payment_ref` | The receipt number of the returned deposit payment exactly as it appears on the returned-payment entry of the agreement ledger | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `amount` | The returned-payment fee charged, in USD | Positive number rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a dictionary rendered as text with: `status` ("booked" when the charge line was written), `purchase_event_id` (reference number of the new charge line), `charge_reference` (the charge number printed on the buyer statement, CHG-HP- followed by four digits), `purchase_id`, `source_payment_ref` (the returned payment's receipt number), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `buyer_charges_due` (USD, 2 decimal places: the fees and per diem the buyer now owes on the agreement). Where no Home Purchase Agreement carries the given reference number, the tool returns an error stating that there is no such Home Purchase Agreement, and nothing is booked.

**Points of the rule, restated.**

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| How many charges per returned payment | One returned-payment fee charge |
| What the charge names | The receipt number of the returned payment |
| Date of the charge | The day it is booked |
| A return whose fee was never booked | Carries its fee from the day the return is next handled |
